row.team_price_text: Infrastructure Edition: from $6 per vCPU/month, billed annually
row.evidence: Splunk AppDynamics documents SAML 2.0 SSO with optional JIT provisioning and an RBAC API that cannot create SAML or LDAP users; no SCIM endpoint appears in the AppDynamics SaaS docs.
row.notes: New row, named for the product sold today (Splunk AppDynamics; slug kept). Pricing is per vCPU/host, not per user: Infrastructure Edition from $6 per vCPU/month, Premium from $33 and Enterprise from $50 per host/month, billed annually, so per-user fields stay null. SAML 2.0 SSO (Okta, OneLogin, Ping, Azure AD, IBM, AD FS certified) is documented with no edition gate stated, so sso_plan is null. Users are created in the Accounts Management Portal (single or pasted list of emails) or by SAML JIT; the Controller RBAC API (basic auth) manages internal users, groups and roles but cannot create SAML or LDAP users. Audit history is available via the ControllerAuditHistory API. Okta's OIN AppDynamics app is SWA only; Entra's gallery app is SAML SSO with JIT. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

endpoints.purpose: Create Cisco Customer Identity user (CI_USER_CREATION accounts only)

limitations.text: RBAC API cannot create SAML or LDAP users and only retrieves internal users unless securityProviderType is passed.

user_api.notes: Controller RBAC API. Users created with it are internal (password) users; SAML/LDAP users cannot be created and are only listed with the securityProviderType parameter. A separate ci-user endpoint creates Cisco Customer Identity users when the account has the CI_USER_CREATION property. The SaaS host pattern is not quoted; examples use localhost.

okta.notes: OIN 'AppDynamics' app (last updated Dec. 2 2016) marks only SWA as supported (read from page markup); SAML, SCIM and provisioning items are unchecked.

entra.notes: Gallery app: SP-initiated SAML SSO with JIT user creation; no automatic provisioning tutorial.

onelogin.notes: AppDynamics' SAML doc certifies OneLogin as a SAML IdP; connector page not checked.

fallbacks.notes: Bulk add is by pasting a list of emails, not CSV upload, so csv_import stays null.
